composition_subtypes.role: Merges per-node distance frequency arrays from children to count pairs at distance k

payload.core_composition_summary: Tree DP with 2D state (node index, distance) computes distance frequency arrays for each subtree and combines them while counting pairs at exact distance k.
payload.rationale: The algorithm is a standard tree DP: it uses a single DP state per node to accumulate distances from descendants, then merges children's shifted arrays to count pairs. No other algorithmic mechanisms (like divide and conquer, heavy-light, etc.) are employed. The stack-based DFS is just an iterative implementation of the recursive tree traversal.
